originalTitle: U.S. stock index futures slide after midterms rally as weak chip earnings weigh
summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures turned abruptly lower on Wednesday evening after a Democrat sweep of Congress in the midterm elections sparked sharp gains on Wall Street.
content:
Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures turned abruptly lower on Wednesday evening after a Democrat sweep of Congress in the midterm elections sparked sharp gains on Wall Street.

Still guessing which stocks will beat the market? Our AI portfolio updates monthly and is outperforming the S&P 500 by 118%. See this month's list »

Nasdaq futures led declines, as underwhelming earnings and guidance from chipmakers Arm and Qualcomm raised more doubts over the artificial intelligence trade.

Focus now turns to more upcoming third-quarter earnings and key labor data for more cues on the economy and interest rates.

S&P 500 Futures fell 0.1% to 7,713.0 points by 20:45 ET (01:45 GMT), Nasdaq 100 Futures slid 0.7% to 28,381.75 points, while Dow Jones Futures fell 0.09% to 53,614.0 points.

Futures reversed course after Wall Street rallied during Wednesday's session, boosted chiefly by the conclusion of the midterm elections clearing a major point of uncertainty for markets.

The S&P 500 surged 1.6%, the NASDAQ Composite jumped 1.4%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average soared 3% in its best session in 19 months.

The Democrats clinched strong majorities in both chambers of Congress, as voters largely rejected the Republicans and President Donald Trump over their handling of inflation and the war with Iran.

The Democrats are expected to pursue policy addressing the cost of living, undoing Trump's tariffs, and potentially ending the war in Iran.

But the Democrats are also expected to pursue more stringent regulation of artificial intelligence and data centers– a notion that sparked sharp losses in data center stocks.

Markets were also wary of potential gridlock in the legislative process, given that a Democrat-led Congress will still have to contend with a Republican White House.

Unsure what to buy ahead of earnings? Our AI's recent pre-earnings calls delivered gains of +77% to +118% after results dropped. See this month's earnings picks »

Trump had earlier signaled he would veto any Democrat-backed legislation, but told the New York Times on Tuesday he would accept the results of the election.

Arm, Qualcomm dip after underwhelming earnings, guidance

British chip designer Arm fell nearly 3% in aftermarket trade, extending losses from a 5% drop in the main session after its current-quarter revenue and profit guidance failed to beat expectations.

The guidance miss largely overshadowed top and bottom-line beats by the company in the September quarter.

Chipmaker Qualcomm also fell about 3% in aftermarket trade after its handset revenue missed expectations in the September quarter.

Investors were also spooked by Qualcomm's warning of rising costs across the chipmaking supply chain, which largely overshadowed an earnings beat for the quarter.

The two were the latest in a line of middling technology earnings, which added to increasing questions over just how much the artificial intelligence trade will pan out in the long term.

Doubts over the AI trade fueled deep losses in tech through October, with Wednesday's losses in Nasdaq futures signaling little slowing in this trend.

The third-quarter earnings season is set to continue on Thursday, with precision engineering firm Parker-Hannifin (NYSE:PH), energy producers Southern Company (NYSE:SO) and Duke Energy Corporation (NYSE:DUK), and homestay platform Airbnb Inc (NASDAQ:ABNB) set to report on Thursday.

Key labor market prints are also due on Thursday and Friday. Weekly jobless claims data and Challenger job cuts readings are due on Thursday, followed by nonfarm payrolls data for October on Friday.

The nonfarm reading is expected to provide more cues on the labor market and will likely factor into the Federal Reserve's plans for interest rates. The central bank is expected to hike rates again in December.

chineseTitle: 由于芯片盈利疲软，美国股指期货在中期上涨后下滑
chineseSummary: Investing.com——周三晚间，民主党在中期选举中横扫国会，引发华尔街股市大幅上涨，美国股指期货突然走低。
chineseContent:
Investing.com——周三晚间，民主党在中期选举中横扫国会，引发华尔街股市大幅上涨，美国股指期货突然走低。

还在猜测哪些股票会跑赢大盘？我们的人工智能投资组合每月更新一次，表现优于标准普尔 500 指数 118%。查看本月列表 »

纳斯达克期货领跌，芯片制造商 Arm 和高通的业绩不佳和指引引发了人们对人工智能行业的更多疑虑。

现在的焦点转向即将到来的第三季度收益和关键劳动力数据，以获取有关经济和利率的更多线索。

截至美国东部时间 20:45（格林威治标准时间 01:45），标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌 0.1%，至 7,713.0 点，纳斯达克 100 期货下跌 0.7%，至 28,381.75 点，道琼斯期货下跌 0.09%，至 53,614.0 点。

周三华尔街上涨后，期货反转，主要是由于中期选举的结束消除了市场的一个主要不确定性。

标准普尔 500 指数上涨 1.6%，纳斯达克综合指数上涨 1.4%，道琼斯工业平均指数飙升 3%，创下 19 个月来的最佳表现。

民主党在参众两院都获得了绝对多数席位，选民们在很大程度上拒绝了共和党和唐纳德·特朗普总统对通货膨胀和伊朗战争的处理方式。

预计民主党将推行解决生活成本、取消特朗普关税并有可能结束伊朗战争的政策。

但预计民主党还将对人工智能和数据中心实行更严格的监管——这一想法引发了数据中心股票的大幅下跌。

鉴于民主党领导的国会仍需与共和党领导的白宫抗衡，市场还对立法过程中可能出现的僵局保持警惕。

不确定在盈利之前买什么？在业绩下滑后，我们的 AI 最近的财报前电话会议带来了 +77% 至 +118% 的涨幅。查看本月收益精选 »

特朗普早些时候曾表示，他将否决任何民主党支持的立法，但周二告诉《纽约时报》，他将接受选举结果。

Arm、高通因盈利和指引不佳而下跌

英国芯片设计公司 Arm 在盘后交易中下跌近 3%，延续了主交易时段下跌 5% 的跌幅，此前该公司本季度营收和利润指引未能超出预期。

该指引的失误在很大程度上掩盖了该公司在九月份季度的营收和净利润的表现。

芯片制造商高通公司在 9 月份季度的手机收入低于预期后，其售后市场交易也下跌了约 3%。

高通公司对整个芯片制造供应链成本上升的警告也令投资者感到震惊，这在很大程度上掩盖了本季度盈利的增长。

这两家公司是一系列中等技术收益中最新的一家，这加剧了人们对人工智能行业长期发展前景的疑问。

对人工智能交易的疑虑导致科技股在 10 月份大幅下跌，周三纳斯达克期货的下跌表明这一趋势几乎没有放缓。

第三季度财报季将于周四继续，精密工程公司 Parker-Hannifin (NYSE:PH)、能源生产商 Southern Company (NYSE:SO) 和 Duke Energy Corporation (NYSE:DUK) 以及民宿平台 Airbnb Inc (NASDAQ:ABNB) 将于周四公布财报。

重要的劳动力市场数据也将于周四和周五发布。每周初请失业金人数数据和挑战者号裁员数据将于周四公布，随后周五公布 10 月份非农就业数据。

非农数据预计将为劳动力市场提供更多线索，并可能纳入美联储的利率计划。预计央行将在 12 月再次加息。
